# Secret-detection CI fixture

# This file contains a deliberately planted fake AWS access key used to verify
# that the secret-scanning job (gitleaks) can detect exposed credentials.

# THIS IS NOT A REAL CREDENTIAL. It matches the AWS key pattern but has never
# been issued by AWS and provides no access to any system.

# The file is excluded from gitleaks scanning via .gitleaks.toml (allowlist.paths).
# The CI job re-scans ONLY this file with --no-git to prove detection works,
# then confirms the main scan (which excludes this path) exits 0.
